content:
Apple has released the first iOS 27 release candidate (RC) for testing. The update brings Apple's next major iPhone software version closer to public release, with Siri AI as the focus of this round of changes.

iOS 27 enters release candidate stage

After a summer of testing, Apple is now making final preparations for the public release of the software.

If no issues are found during testing that require a new version, Apple will officially release this build. Apple may still push out additional release candidates before the final release.

Developers can download the update via Settings > General > Software Update. If you're already running the iOS 27 developer beta, you'll find the update there.

Siri AI is at the core of iOS 27

The most important part of iOS 27 is Siri AI, a redesigned assistant that offers more natural conversational responses, personalised contextual awareness, on-screen content understanding, and expanded actions across more apps.

Apple has also added a dedicated Siri app for browsing past conversation history, a new interface built around Dynamic Island, and a Siri Camera mode that brings Visual Intelligence into the experience.

Beyond Siri, Apple has also added AI features across Photos, Safari, Mail, Messages, Shortcuts and other apps.

More iOS 27 features and changes

iOS 27 builds on last year's Liquid Glass redesign with more customisation options, including a transparency slider.

Other changes include: keyword search and star ratings in the Photos app, customisable slideshow playback, FaceTime dual-camera capture, customisable EQ for AirPods, and easier Apple Pay credit card switching.

Apple has also focused on performance improvements, including app launch speed, photo loading, AirDrop transfers, and switching between Wi-Fi and mobile networks.

If we spot anything notable in the release candidate, we'll update this story.
